text_block_list.text: The storm—as expected—had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san. You made it in time for the Kikuka Sho, didn't you? A spot on the gate is practically guaranteed now!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: "You're being called the 'biggest dark horse if you run'—do you intend to enter the race?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I shall participate.
I spent my entire summer preparing with that very intention, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you came after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's go. I need to talk to them...

Before the decisive battle, Mejiro Ryan seemed to want
to confirm how we both felt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...McQueen isn't here yet, is she?
This was definitely where we agreed to meet..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
...Am I late?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, that might have been faster than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The media's been calling McQueen a dark horse, but that's not true at all, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is true. I haven't changed.
It is merely how others perceive me that has changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, they are saying that about *you*—
'We never expected her to take center stage in the Classics.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Isn't that spot-on?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It did not hit me.
For I knew it wouldn't from the start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You simply hadn't noticed it yet.

――Two who understand each other deeply.
That is why this cannot be settled with cheap tricks.

Unless you surpass her in sheer ability,
you cannot defeat Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "So, Ryan, did you find anything better than me?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is 3,000 meters.
As a stayer, that is right in my domain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just as we tested in the mock race before, without any countermeasures, the advantage is ours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What weapon do you possess that could possibly defeat me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My... weapon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: W-Well, there are a lot of reasons, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Driving power, burst of speed, physical resilience,
a powerful late kick, all sorts of things... But...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Will this really work?
Against McQueen, who's beaten me so many times...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm scared... So scared...
All I can remember from when I was little is losing...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Can I really compete? With what little I have... nothing at all... Uuu...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Muscles...? Trainer,
whatever are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of the splendor of muscle.
And equally aware that muscle alone cannot defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-That's right. Trainer, muscles alone aren't...

We move to the pool.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, I've changed, 
but did you need something...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is... different.
Completely different from spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
While retaining the same firmness, her body is even more
suited for practical racing... This is—
choice_data_list: It's the fruit of doing the right kind of hard work.
It's the fruit of doing the right kind of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what does "proper effort" mean...?

I talk about the journey so far.
It's true that Mejiro Ryan can't match
Mejiro McQueen when it comes to perfection.

"Still, that's precisely why I never stopped working hard.
I turned my inferiority complex into muscle and fought on."
A mud-soaked youth spent alongside my best friend. Born from raw vulnerability and fierce rivalry—is this very body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... It is plain as day.
One look at this body tells all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, you have walked an unwavering path
with tremendous speed, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is that so? I don't really
understand it that well, to be honest."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you truly never understand, do you?
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is precisely because you are who you are that you've been able to move forward without wavering. Alongside a wonderful partner, no less.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"She is a worthy opponent.
Have faith, Ryan."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Believe in the you that Trainer-san and I believe in. If you give it your all,
it will surely be a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As long as I give it everything... Y-Yeah...
That's one promise I can definitely keep!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can say with absolute confidence that I worked my hardest for this day.
Just so I could beat you!!

Having somehow gained the confidence to compete,
Mejiro Ryan prepares for the clash within the Mejiro family—which is about to begin.
